title: Parity sum over coordinate colorings
statement: Let $n\ge 0$ and $m>0$ be integers, let $j_0\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, and let $T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For each coloring $\pi:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, let $F_{j_0}(\pi)=\{i:\pi(i)=j_0\}$. Then $\sum_{\pi}(-1)^{|T\cap F_{j_0}(\pi)|}=m^n(1-2/m)^{|T|}$, where the sum is over all such colorings.
hypotheses_covered: The number of coordinates $n$ is a natural number
The number of colors $m$ is positive
$T$ is a subset of the coordinates
replaced: Let $n\ge0$, $m>0$ be integers, $j_0\in[m]$, and $T\subseteq[n]$. For $F_{j_0}(\pi)=\{i\in[n]:\pi(i)=j_0\}$, the sum over all colorings satisfies $\sum_{\pi:[n]\to[m]}(-1)^{|T\cap F_{j_0}(\pi)|}=m^n(1-2/m)^{|T|}$.
